whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Anmol Pal Hotel,

I noticed your hotel has built a massive following with nearly 3,000 reviews on Buddh Marg in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and room showcase page.

Maine aapke hotel ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp room booking, dining menu, aur event facilities integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/anmolpal

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Anmol Pal Hotel team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke hotel (Anmol Pal Hotel, Buddh Marg) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp room booking and your prime location highlights near ISCON Temple. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact room categories, pricing aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
